iti36:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti36:2.1: nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhanatthaṃ janalapanatthaṃ lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ ‘iti maṃ jano jānātū’ti.
iti36:2.2: atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati abhiññatthañceva pariññatthañcāti.
iti36:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
